summary.zhHans: 在《逃离方块：阿尔勒》中出现的白色方块意象；具体取得方式按游玩进度隐藏。
summary.en: A white-cube motif appearing in Cube Escape: Arles; the exact way it is obtained is hidden according to play progress.

zhHans.text: 《逃离方块：阿尔勒》后段，角色与镜中的腐化倒影发生冲突后得到白色方块，并与黑色方块共同作用于最终出口。

en.text: Late in Cube Escape: Arles, the character obtains a white cube after confronting the corrupted mirror image; it works together with the black cube at the final exit.

reason.zhHans: 涉及《逃离方块：阿尔勒》的后段剧情。
reason.en: Contains later-story information from Cube Escape: Arles.
